 KNWA Fayetteville Follow UAFS hosts Halloween-themed FAFSA event
 Jordan Moeller Fri, October 30, 2026 at 12:06 PM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. FORT SMITH, Ark. (KNWA/KFTA) — At the University of Arkansas Fort Smith, they celebrated Halloween with a little paperwork.
 They're hosting their annual Halloween-themed Freaky FAFSA event, a free drop-in event that assists students and families in completing their FAFSA forms.
 Students who attend and complete their FAFSA by December 1 will be eligible to win one of five $1,000 scholarships for the 2027-2028 academic year.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Over 80% of UAFS students depend on some form of financial aid, so this event can be a major help.
  Fayetteville School Board votes to give employees bonuses  
 "Paying for college can be such an intense and almost kind of scary conversation," Assistant Director of Client Services for Financial AidChristina Castorena said. "So why not make the scary fun, right? So forgive FAFSA, let's decorate with some skeletons and graveyards and have some good food. And it's enjoyable because we don't have to have such a serious conversation all the time and we can make it fun."
 One scholarship recipient has already been announced, with the other four to be announced after December 1st.
